correctness.rationale: For q=3 the all-positive trace bounds one-side tested palette size, mixed supports force a distinct constant tested colour on each side and prohibit simultaneous positive/negative tests on both sides; an explicit construction realizes every remaining trace. Counting disjoint types gives the full generating polynomial, checked for eight parameter pairs through (4,4). The q=3 online upper bound uses the exact number of positively responding concepts, which is below the 2^(max(m,n)+1) leaves required at the root positive child of depth max(m,n)+2; matching VC gives equality. q=2 uses two colourings, and q>=4 has a full-vertex shattered witness and the general all-positive-branch upper bound. The standalone checker exhaustively verifies 8 polynomial cases and 15 exact small online cases; finite checks are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The core statement determines every three-colour shattered query support and every coefficient of a natural shattering polynomial for all complete bipartite graphs, not just a numerical rank. Its structural two-side restriction produces a sharp transition from larger-part-controlled dimension at q=3 to vertex-count dimension at q>=4, and explains equality of static/adaptive ranks despite nearby path and cycle classes separating them. This exact classification is independently mathematically motivated by graph-colouring concept-family complexity; the simple endpoint cases are presented as context, not as isolated discoveries.
